title: picea mariana var. brevifolia
intro: Picea mariana var. brevifolia, commonly known as White Spruce, is a variety of evergreen tree native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of White Spruce include sedation, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Picea mariana var. brevifolia include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
